ऌ: ऌ ऌ, ind. the earth; a mountain; the mother of the gods; the divine nature; a mystical letter. —लृ-कार, अस्, m. the letter or sound ऌ। —लृ-वर्ण, अम्, n. the vowel ऌ।
ऌङ्: ऌङ् ऌङ्, a technical term or symbol for the terminations of the Conditional or for that Mood itself.
ऌट्: ऌट् ऌट्, a technical term or symbol for the terminations of the Second Future or for that Tense itself.
